title: What is createSlice in Redux Toolkit and how does it simplify Redux code?
expectedConcepts: Combines actions and reducers in a single file/function
Requires name, initialState, and reducers object
Automatically generates action creators matching reducer keys
Eliminates boilerplate switch statements and manual action type constants
hints: Before RTK, you had to write action types, action creators, and reducers in separate files.
What object does counterSlice.actions give you?

codingExercise.instruction: Define a simple slice named "theme" with initialState { mode: "light" } and a reducer toggleTheme that flips between "light" and "dark".
codingExercise.expectedOutput: createSlice with toggleTheme reducer mutating mode
